scope: local P17 DVH engine volume weighting and cumulative-DVH metric oracle
contract: D(x) groups observed dose levels, accumulates volume in descending dose order, and linearly interpolates between adjacent cumulative-volume points.
D0 and D100 clamp to Dmax and Dmin; no extrapolation is used.
V(x) sums volume for dose >= threshold and returns both cc and percent.
The convention is pinned in business-analysis.md, specification.md, and technical-specification.md and is included in the engine/result provenance contract.
